Aisha (product): Heads-up — ACME Corp asked for an explicit roadmap on private deploys with customer-managed networking + non-disruptive upgrades. They want timelines and hard launch criteria by EOW. Key asks: VPC peering, IP preservation, DNS handoff, and a rollback plan.
Tom W. (eng-runtime): Thanks — we can do VPC peering + config-driven DNS handoff in a single slice, but full IP preservation across upgrades (no change to tenant IPs) needs infra work (CNI shim, NAT rules) — estimate 6-8w.
Jade L. (field): ACME is sensitive to downtime windows; they will only accept upgrades with max 5 min outage per tenant. They also asked for audit logs and KMS support.
Priya S. (solutions): Can we offer an interim: managed peering + staged rollout (canary tenants) + documented manual rollback? That might be enough for their security/compliance teams initially.
Tom W. (eng-runtime): Yes — staging canary + automated fallback is feasible in ~3w if we scope out IP-preservation and airgap requests. We'll need a config flag to toggle "preserve_ips": true/false at deploy time.
Aisha (product): Proposal: ship v1 for Q3: "Managed peering + DNS handoff + canary rollouts + rollback playbook + audit logs". Defer IP-preservation and full airgap to v2. Agree? Decision by Friday.
Jade L. (field): ACME will accept v1 if we include: (1) handoff doc for NetOps, (2) SLA for upgrade window, (3) test plan they can run. Can we commit to those?
Tom W. (eng-runtime): We can commit to the code/APIs and a standard test harness. SLA conversation needs legal/finance but engineering can target 99.9% for control-plane work; data-plane PDNs are trickier.
Priya S. (solutions): I'll draft the NetOps handoff doc and test checklist. Quick template: steps to validate peering, DNS TTL change, canary promotion, rollback. Snippet: ```
# canary promotion
curl -X POST https://env.redwood/api/promote -d '{"tenant":"acme-canary"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://env.redwood/api/rollback -d '{"tenant":"acme-canary"}'
```
netops-bot: Checklist created: /docs/private-deploys/acme-handshake.md (internal). Owner: Priya S. Reviewers: Tom W., Jade L.
Aisha (product): Action items: Priya to deliver doc by Wed, Tom to prototype preserve_ips opt and canary toggle by Fri, Jade to confirm ACME legal asks by Thu. If any slips, we escalate to PM leadership.
Tom W. (eng-runtime): Note — dependency: we need a small change in our installer to allow customer-managed route tables (scoped flag). I'll open an RFC and link it here.
Jade L. (field): ACME also asked about cost implications for reserved capacity during upgrades. I'll capture cost constraints in the handoff doc.
Aisha (product): Ok team — sounds like consensus for v1 approach. Final decision: ship v1 (peering + DNS handoff + canary/rollback + audit logs) as Q3 target; v2 (IP-preserve + airgap/on-prem installer gap) scheduled for Q4 cadence after success metrics. We'll present this in Friday steering. :thumbsup:
